title: Browser authority control-plane contract (B1-R5)
description: Structure of the frozen contract consumed by tools/browser-authority-runner.mjs. Carries field LABELS and env VARIABLE NAMES only — never values. The authoritative browser run itself remains a later, separately authorized gate.

owner_field.description: Field KEY designated as the journey owner (HC07 protagonist). Projected into the materialized input as owner_email_label; overwrite-forbidden by the control plane.

fields.description: Declared materializable fields. Labels and env variable NAMES only.

transitions.description: The complete set of legal control-plane transitions; every edge is (from, to) and `from` must equal the captured current state.

max_starts.description: The browser authority command starts at most once.
